headline: 완전 자동화를 막는 context 문제는 세 가지 보충적 구조 결함의 합성: (1) 셸 상태 비영속성으로 강제된 변수 재파생 18회, (2) 게이트 계약이 토큰만 검사하고 내용/권한은 검증 없음, (3) detached runner 패턴이 존재하되 명령 본문 전역 적용되지 않음.

findings.claim: Shell state doesn't cross tool call boundaries; 18 REVIEW_DIR re-derivations in plan.md alone force variable recreation at each phase halt.
findings.why_it_blocks_the_goal: Unattended automation can't hand off context across tool calls. Each phase boundary loses all bash-state variables, forcing re-derivation.

findings.claim: plan.md Phase 4 outputs 'WAITING FOR CONFIRMATION' markdown requiring user input. No env bypass. Blocks unattended `/mccp:work` chain.
findings.evidence: plan.md:584 literal 'WAITING FOR CONFIRMATION', no auto-confirm toggle in phase body
findings.why_it_blocks_the_goal: Plan halts and waits for next utterance. No resume. `/mccp:work` calling `/mccp:plan` produces artifact + halts (no auto-dispatch to prp-implement).

findings.claim: Multiple command fences maintain separate state serializations (STATE.md, work-orchestrator step record, santa-loop ledger, evidence-audit markers). No unified state-bridge contract.
findings.evidence: state-writer.js, work-orchestrator.js:326, santa-loop.md Phase 7, evidence-audit.js (four distinct patterns)
findings.why_it_blocks_the_goal: State handoff is brittle. No SoT for 'what state survives phase boundaries'. Coordination cost explodes with parallel dispatch.

findings.claim: No metric for unattended automation completion rate. Can't detect which phases actually block vs. appear to block due to process design.
findings.evidence: `/mccp:work` telemetry missing from work.md/work-orchestrator.js. Observable only via log inspection.
findings.why_it_blocks_the_goal: Improvements (l1-content, phase4-bypass) only prioritized if blocking rates are measured. Current state unknown. Can't prove Phase 4 is bottleneck.

recommendations.title: Generalize detached-runner + nonce-sealing pattern to all command-body fence contexts
recommendations.what: Extract plan-codex-runner.js architecture into shared lib/runners/detached.js. Refactor plan, prp-implement, pr, santa-loop fences to invoke Node sub-processes with nonce sealing instead of inline bash state.
recommendations.expected_effect: Remove 18 REVIEW_DIR assignments + ~400 lines of boilerplate per command. Single handoff channel across all phase boundaries. Enable `/mccp:work` unattended via detached runner chain.

recommendations.title: Mechanize plan.md Phase 4 confirmation bypass for unattended mode
recommendations.what: Add env toggle MCCP_PLAN_AUTO_CONFIRM (yes/no/ask). Phase 4 reads toggle; if 'yes', emit confirmation marker. Wire toggle into `/mccp:work` as implicit 'yes'.
recommendations.expected_effect: Phase 4 no longer blocks unattended `/mccp:work`. User still gets prompt when invoking `/mccp:plan` directly.

recommendations.title: Mechanize l1-check.js C4 (Validate field content)
recommendations.what: Create l1-content.js validating Validate field is non-placeholder AND Validation block output matches claim AND Acceptance is per-task checklist (not boilerplate).
recommendations.expected_effect: Gate contracts move from L1 (tokens) to L3 (content). Per-task gate outcomes machine-verifiable.

recommendations.title: Unify state-bridge contract across all fences
recommendations.what: Create lib/state-bridge.js with deterministic contract: enterPhase(phase, priorState) -> sealed state object, exitPhase(phase, result) -> sealed marker + next-state. Wire all fences to use this.
recommendations.expected_effect: State persistence is testable and reusable. Eliminates REVIEW_DIR re-derivations. Unattended `/mccp:work` can hand off context deterministically.

recommendations.title: Enforce round-cap code default = 1 with audit
recommendations.what: Hardcode cap=1 in plan.js/prp-implement.js. Read MCCP_GATE_ROUND_CAP env only if explicitly set. Add lint verifying invariant.
recommendations.expected_effect: CLAUDE.md prose becomes mechanical law. Code default (1) is unambiguous.

recommendations.title: Establish `/mccp:work` unattended completion telemetry
recommendations.what: Instrument work.md + work-orchestrator.js to emit completion markers. Query weekly to measure % of runs reaching done without user intervention.
recommendations.expected_effect: First measurement of unattended success rate. Exposes actual bottleneck phases. Enables data-driven prioritization.

metrics_proposed.name: Shell state re-derivation frequency
metrics_proposed.definition: Count of variable assignments re-executing git/fs queries per gate run (e.g., REVIEW_DIR assignments). Numerator: re-derivations. Denominator: total assignments.
metrics_proposed.producer: grep -n 'REVIEW_DIR=' across command fences. Count per gate, per phase.
metrics_proposed.why: Direct cost of context loss. Target: 0 per phase.
